features.name: Local Currency Setup
features.description: Ability to configure the local currency (LCY) that a business uses in the country or region where it trades domestically through the General Ledger Setup page.
caveats: LCY should not be listed among the currencies in the currencies table

features.name: LCY Code Configuration
features.description: Setting the LCY code (local currency code) in General Ledger Setup, demonstrated with USD example, which identifies the local currency used by the business.

features.name: Local Currency Symbol Configuration
features.description: Setting the local currency symbol that will display at various places around the system to represent the configured local currency.

features.name: Currency Description
features.description: Ability to describe and name the currency in General Ledger Setup, allowing users to specify what the currency is called.

features.name: Currency Code in Orders
features.description: When creating orders, users should not specify the currency code unless it is different from the local currency, such as when trading in a foreign currency.
caveats: Only specify currency code when different from local currency

features.name: Currencies Table Verification
features.description: Checking that the local currency is not listed among the currencies in the currencies table, ensuring only foreign currencies in which the business trades are included.
caveats: LCY should not appear in the currencies table
